resources.title: FFmpeg
resources.description: FFmpeg is a free and open-source software project consisting of a suite of libraries and programs for handling video, audio, and other multimedia files and streams. It is widely used for format transcoding, basic editing, and standards compliance.

resources.title: FFmpeg IRC channels (#ffmpeg, #ffmpeg-devel on Libera.Chat)
resources.description: Official FFmpeg real-time community channels: #ffmpeg for user support, #ffmpeg-devel for development discussion, logged and active.
